series: GT World Challenge Europe Endurance Cup
event_preview:
The Nurburgring Grand Prix circuit is a 5.148 km (3.199 mi), 15-turn permanent road course in Nurburg, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany, the modern GP-Strecke used by GT World Challenge Europe, not the Nordschleife. The layout opens through the Mercedes Arena, runs the Schumacher S and finishes through the NGK chicane. The 3 Hours of Nurburgring is the fourth of five GT World Challenge Europe Endurance Cup rounds in 2026, scheduled for Sunday, 30 August. A 55-car field is entered across four classes: 18 Pro, 8 Gold Cup, 16 Silver Cup and 13 Bronze Cup.

Mercedes-AMG Team Mann-Filter's Lucas Auer, Luca Stolz and Maro Engel lead the overall standings on 74 points after three rounds. Comtoyou Racing's Mattia Drudi, Marco Sorensen and Nicki Thiim sit second on 33 after winning the season-opening 6 Hours of Paul Ricard. A Silver Cup Audi from Tresor Attempto Racing (Rocco Mazzola, Sebastian Ogaard and Ariel Levi) won the 3 Hours of Monza overall. Lionspeed GP's Ricardo Feller, Thomas Preining and Bastian Buus won the CrowdStrike 24 Hours of Spa. ROWE Racing returns to its home event with Jake Dennis, Augusto Farfus and Raffaele Marciello in the No. 98 BMW; Farfus and Marciello won this race in 2025 with Jesse Krohn. Valentino Rossi shares the No. 46 Team WRT BMW with Dan Harper and Max Hesse. Gold Cup is led by Tom Fleming, Louis Prette and Benjamin Goethe; Silver Cup by Ignacio Montenegro, Amaury Cordeel, Mathieu Detry and Matisse Lismont; Bronze Cup by Kessel Racing's Dustin Blattner, Ben Tuck, Mathys Jaubert and Dennis Marschall, the Spa class winners.

The fastest documented GT World Challenge Europe Endurance Cup qualifying lap at the Nurburgring GP circuit is Thomas Preining's 1:53.612 in Qualifying 3 in 2025.
event_preview_ru:
Grand Prix-конфигурация Nurburgring — постоянная трасса длиной 5,148 км (3,199 мили) с 15 поворотами в Nurburg, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany: современная GP-Strecke, на которой выступает GT World Challenge Europe, а не Nordschleife. Лейаут открывается комплексом Mercedes Arena, проходит Schumacher S и заканчивается шиканой NGK. 3 Hours of Nurburgring — четвёртый из пяти этапов GT World Challenge Europe Endurance Cup 2026, запланирован на воскресенье, 30 августа. Заявлено 55 машин в четырёх классах: 18 Pro, 8 Gold Cup, 16 Silver Cup и 13 Bronze Cup.

Экипаж Mercedes-AMG Team Mann-Filter Lucas Auer, Luca Stolz и Maro Engel лидирует в общем зачёте с 74 очками после трёх этапов. Comtoyou Racing — Mattia Drudi, Marco Sorensen и Nicki Thiim — вторые с 33 очками после победы на старте сезона в 6 Hours of Paul Ricard. Серебряный Audi Tresor Attempto Racing (Rocco Mazzola, Sebastian Ogaard и Ariel Levi) выиграл 3 Hours of Monza в абсолюте. Lionspeed GP — Ricardo Feller, Thomas Preining и Bastian Buus — выиграли CrowdStrike 24 Hours of Spa. ROWE Racing возвращается на домашний этап с Jake Dennis, Augusto Farfus и Raffaele Marciello на BMW No. 98; Farfus и Marciello выиграли эту гонку в 2025 году вместе с Jesse Krohn. Valentino Rossi делит BMW No. 46 Team WRT с Dan Harper и Max Hesse. Gold Cup возглавляют Tom Fleming, Louis Prette и Benjamin Goethe; Silver Cup — Ignacio Montenegro, Amaury Cordeel, Mathieu Detry и Matisse Lismont; Bronze Cup — экипаж Kessel Racing Dustin Blattner, Ben Tuck, Mathys Jaubert и Dennis Marschall, победители класса на Spa.

Самый быстрый задокументированный квалификационный круг GT World Challenge Europe Endurance Cup на GP-конфигурации Nurburgring — Thomas Preining, 1:53.612 в Qualifying 3 в 2025 году.
